title: Data and RAG Management
summary: This module provides comprehensive capabilities for managing data and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows. It includes functionalities for file processing, caching, knowledge source integration, and vector store management, enabling efficient data handling and retrieval for AI agents.

nodes.label: File Processing & Caching
nodes.title: File Processing & Caching
nodes.description: Manages file lifecycle, input normalization, resolution (upload/inline), metadata caching, and cleanup, integrating with external providers.

nodes.label: Knowledge Source Management
nodes.title: Knowledge Source Management
nodes.description: Provides specialized loaders for various file types (e.g., Docling, Excel) to prepare content as knowledge sources for RAG systems.

nodes.label: RAG Vector Store Integrations
nodes.title: RAG Vector Store Integrations
nodes.description: Integrates various vector databases (LanceDB, Couchbase, MongoDB, Qdrant, Weaviate) into RAG workflows, defining embedding functions and collection management.

groups.label: Data Ingestion & Processing
groups.title: Data Ingestion & Processing
groups.description: Handles the initial intake, standardization, and caching of raw data files for further use.

groups.label: Knowledge Base Management
groups.title: Knowledge Base Management
groups.description: Manages the conversion of processed files into structured knowledge sources suitable for RAG.

groups.label: RAG Vector Store Integration
groups.title: RAG Vector Store Integration
groups.description: Integrates and manages various vector databases for efficient storage and retrieval of RAG-ready knowledge.
